svg.title: The Touch Down loop: a circular task cycle, then a release path
svg.desc: Steps 1 to 3 (write a task, file an issue, build it) repeat in a circle for several cycles. When the loop is done, steps 4 to 6 run once: push to github-ci, Xcode Cloud builds TestFlight, then you play on your phone. Your own prompts for main features go straight to the push step.
